title: ailas
description: displays data about what you're looking at. port of Hwyla to Ornithe.
body:
# Am I Looking At Something?

#### AILAS - a fork of [HWYLA](https://github.com/TehNut-Mods/HWYLA) by [TehNut](https://github.com/TehNut). this fork is permitted under the [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://github.com/danilwhale/ailas/blob/fabric/merged/LICENSE.md) license. 

ailas has been based off '1.14_fabric' branch with few changes from '1.16_fabric' backported.

the mod will be available exclusively for [Ornithe](https://ornithemc.net). if you want to use it with Forge or Fabric for versions in 1.10.2-1.16.5 range, use [Hwyla](https://modrinth.com/mod/hwyla) instead.

## modpack permissions

feel free to use this mod in any modpack.
